memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of insomnia and psoriasis.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports difficulty falling asleep, waking twice nightly, and mild scalp psoriasis flaring over past month.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 58 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 24.1 (overweight). Skin shows mild erythematous plaques on elbows and scalp, no active infection.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia moderate, psoriasis mild. Liver enzymes normal, CBC within limits, TSH 2.1 mIU/L, Hb 12.8 g/dL.
ARRANGEMENTS: Advised weight management and daily walk. Continue melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, clobetasol 0.05% cream BD, calcipotriol ointment OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD. Offered influenza vaccine; patient to receive in autumn. Return if new joint pain, worsening rash, fever >39°C, chest pain, or bleeding.

Reason for visit: follow-up on insomnia and psoriasis.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports improved sleep onset but still wakes once nightly; scalp psoriasis less itchy, mild flare on elbows.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82 mmHg, weight 57.5 kg, BMI 23.9 (overweight). Skin shows faint scaling on elbows, clear scalp.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia mild‑moderate, psoriasis stable. Labs show Hb 13.0 g/dL, TSH 2.0, LFT unchanged.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds; advise light evening stretching. Influenza vaccine not due yet. Return if worsening rash, new joint swelling, fever >39°C, or severe daytime fatigue.

Reason for visit: autumn review and influenza vaccination.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports good sleep, rare awakenings; psoriasis quiet, only occasional dry patches.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/80 mmHg, weight 57 kg, BMI 23.7 (overweight). Skin clear, no active lesions.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia well controlled, psoriasis in remission. Hb 13.2 g/dL, TSH 2.1, lipid profile: total cholesterol 180 mg/dL, HDL 48, LDL 102, triglycerides 130.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue meds. Administered influenza vaccine today (02‑Oct‑2025). Advised maintain activity and balanced diet. Return if new rash, joint pain, fever >39°C, or breathing difficulty.

Reason for visit: winter check‑up, mild psoriasis flare noted.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports increased scalp itching over past two weeks, sleep unchanged.
EXAMINATION: BP 135/83 mmHg, weight 56.8 kg, BMI 23.6 (overweight). Scalp shows mild erythema with fine scaling; elbows clear.
IMPRESSION: Psoriasis mild flare, insomnia stable. LFT shows ALT 34 U/L (still normal), Hb 13.1 g/dL.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current regimen; add topical calcipotriol BD to scalp for two weeks. Advise moisturiser. Return if rash spreads, joint pain, fever >39°C, or severe sleep disruption.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: annual review, medication tolerance.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports good sleep, no waking; psoriasis quiet after scalp treatment.
EXAMINATION: BP 132/78 mmHg, weight 56.5 kg, BMI 23.5 (overweight). Skin clear, no active plaques.
IMPRESSION: Insomnia controlled, psoriasis in remission. Labs: Hb 13.3 g/dL, TSH 2.0, lipid profile: total cholesterol 175, HDL 50, LDL 98, triglycerides 125; LFT normal.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue meds. Discuss osteoporosis prevention – calcium‑vit D supplement. Influenza vaccine to be given in autumn. Return if new joint swelling, skin rash, fever >39°C, or chest pain.
